# Huashu bird stickers - selected bedroom decoration

Six selected sticker images are used as decoration for the seasonal bedroom. The artwork is by Huashu (alchaincyf), from huashu-bird-sticker:
https://github.com/alchaincyf/huashu-bird-sticker

**All six sticker images, including converted PNGs or derived texture atlases, remain under PolyForm Shield 1.0.0. They are not CC0 and are not MIT-licensed artwork.**

The upstream LICENSE.md explicitly permits games, commercial use, modification and redistribution, while excluding products competing with Mingji's bird-watching, bird-identification or bird field-guide products. The Shield license text governs. Do not relicense these images under the project's own license or include them in the existing CC0 attribution group.

## Retained records

- LICENSE.md and NOTICE.md: unchanged upstream scope, required notice and third-party disclosures.
- LICENSES/PolyForm-Shield-1.0.0.md: complete unchanged sticker license.
- LICENSES/MIT.txt and data/README.md: unchanged terms and field descriptions for the small extracted provenance record.
- source-manifest.json: only six selected sticker paths, original SHA256 values, sticker license, and recorded reference authors/pages/licenses. No complete 35 MB dataset, multilingual bird-name collection, traits or field-guide prose is included.
- THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt: compact attribution and license URL suitable for inclusion next to a game build, together with the retained license texts.

The original WEBP files are archived only in the production directory ThirdParty/Huashu_Bird_Stickers/originals/. The Git documentation copy intentionally contains documentation only; runtime image conversion and placement are performed separately. source-manifest.json identifies the original WEBP bytes, not hashes of later PNG/atlas derivatives.

## Reference scope

The six recorded reference sources are marked CC0 1.0 or Public domain by the local upstream data. Those labels concern the reference photographs or illustration, not the sticker license. They were not independently checked online for this integration. Reference images themselves are not copied. Individual reference authors and pages are retained in source-manifest.json.

Original data/README.md and NOTICE.md mention upstream datasets and paths, including species.json and field-guide text, that are deliberately not copied here. Only the six extracted source records are included. Broader IOC, AVONET or field-guide data would require a separate terms review and attribution if added later.

## Distribution notice

Anyone receiving any part of the sticker artwork must also receive the Shield terms or their URL and the upstream Required Notice. Ensure the packaged game carries these notices; a file left only in Git docs is not included automatically in a Unity build. No credits-screen UI is required by the retained local text, but the required accompanying notice must reach recipients.

Required Notice: Copyright (c) 2026 Huashu (alchaincyf), https://github.com/alchaincyf/huashu-bird-sticker
